title: Community-based homelessness prevention services to households that are at risk of entering the shelter system

description_text:
The New York City Human Resources Administration, through its provision of community-based homelessness prevention services, intends to renew one (1) contract with the contractor listed below for households that are at risk of entering into the shelter system.

Services for the Underserved Inc

463 7th Avenue, 17th Floor

New York, NY 10018

EPIN: 06924P0008007R001

The renewal term of the contract will be from 07/01/2027  06/30/2030. Anyone who has comments on the performance of the contractor, or the proposed renewal of the contracts may contact Stacey Cedeno at (929) 221-5887.

This notice is for informational purposes only.
